title: You see broken.
paragraphs:
You see broken.
God sees chosen.
So many people look in the mirror and only see their flaws, failures, and past mistakes.
But God doesn’t see you the way your fear does.
He sees someone fearfully and wonderfully made.

Someone worth dying for.
Someone worth restoring.
Someone worth calling His child.
The enemy wants you to believe you’re not enough.
But the cross already declared your value.

Psalm 139:14
“I praise You because I am fearfully and wonderfully made.”
If you’ve ever struggled with feeling not good enough…
